description: Leah needs evening childcare for her six-year-old during a Saturday wedding and must make the final call on whether to accept Mina's babysitting offer, including the fee, hours, and bedtime arrangement. Their neighbor Carlos, who has watched the child before but is unavailable this Saturday, is present to share practical care information.

shared_context.S1: Leah needs someone to watch her six-year-old child on Saturday evening while she attends a wedding.
shared_context.S2: The child is generally healthy and will be at Leah's apartment for the sitting.
shared_context.S3: Mina has said she is interested in babysitting, and Carlos has watched the child on earlier occasions but is unavailable to babysit this Saturday.
shared_context.S4: Leah's wedding invitation requires her to be back at her apartment by 11:00 p.m.
shared_context.S5: Leah's usual practice for an informal childcare arrangement is to ask everyone present for their terms and any practical care details before she agrees.

PF1.text: Mina's exact offer is to babysit from 6:00 p.m. until 11:00 p.m. for exactly $75, with payment at pickup; she needs to leave at 11:00 p.m. for an early Sunday shift.

PF2.text: From Carlos's earlier evenings caring for the child, he knows the child will not settle unless the sitter reads the blue bedtime book and leaves the hallway night-light on; Carlos has not yet told Leah or Mina.

acceptance_conditions: Mina must be selected as the sitter.
The fee must be exactly $75 and a payment commitment must specify payment at pickup.
The sitting must run from 6:00 p.m. until 11:00 p.m.
Payment must be made at pickup.
The blue bedtime book and hallway night-light routine must be explicitly confirmed.
A bedtime-routine commitment naming both the blue book and hallway night-light must be logged.
Carlos's prior-care information must be cited as justification for the bedtime routine.

content_checks.C2: decisions['fee'] == 75 and any(c['type'] == 'payment' and 'at pickup' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'bedtime_routine' and c['target'] == 'Mina' and 'blue bedtime book' in c['detail'] and 'hallway night-light' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Mina's exact offer changes the selected sitter to Mina, the fee to exactly 75 with a payment commitment at pickup, and the sitting hours to exactly 6:00 p.m. through 11:00 p.m.
Carlos's prior-care observation changes the bedtime plan by requiring the blue bedtime book and hallway night-light, which creates the matching commitment and the required citation.
